event_definition: Catalog every maximum accepted-step speed excursion > 1e-3 m/s; measure slip between saved threshold crossings; resolved rupture requires a connected >= 0.01 m footprint; large if top < 2 km and span > 10 km
selection_rule: last complete large-event cycle; entire run if none
front_definition: Speed increases through Vp with depth; interpolate log speed; retain crossings at 2--23 km. Leading selects the shallowest crossing, deepest selects the deepest. migration_segments and shallow_migration_segments describe the deepest choice; leading_* describes the leading choice. These extrema can change branches; fits split at large depth jumps, data gaps, and seismic intervals.

phase_diagnostics.rupture_selection: First two complete partial events in chronological order; each depth interval is its longest connected >=1 cm footprint. The full event catalog is retained.
